tips.title: Search
tips.tip: Find anything you had open
tips.body: Apps, tabs, windows, agents and files. Type a few letters, then Return.

tips.title: Actions
tips.tip: Every row has more actions
tips.body: Copy a link, bookmark it, or give it an alias or a hotkey.

tips.title: Section Pills
tips.tip: Show one section of the list at a time
tips.body: The pills are your recent apps. ⇧⇥ goes back, Esc shows everything.

tips.title: Search Current App
tips.tip: Search the front app's menus and pages
tips.body: Its pages, settings and menu commands, each with its keys.

tips.title: Aliases
tips.tip: Give any row a short alias
tips.body: Type the alias in Search and it comes first, ready for Return.

tips.title: Row Hotkeys
tips.tip: Give any row its own hotkey in ⌘K
tips.body: A page, a tab, an agent: one key takes you there from any app.

tips.title: Back
tips.tip: Jump back to where you just were
tips.body: Hold ⌃⌥ to see where you've been, then let go. ↑ goes forward.

tips.title: Toggle
tips.tip: Flip between your last two apps
tips.body: Tap twice again to come back.

tips.title: Toggle Tab
tips.tip: Flip between your last two tabs
tips.body: Works for windows and sessions too.

tips.title: Agents
tips.tip: See every agent from anywhere
tips.body: The ones waiting on you are on top. Return takes you there.

tips.title: Next Agent
tips.tip: Jump to the next agent that needs you
tips.body: Needs You first, then Done. Press it again within a minute for the next.

tips.title: Clipboard History
tips.tip: Bring back anything you copied
tips.body: Pick one and press Return to paste it where you were. Password managers' copies are skipped.

needs.note: Clipboard History is off until you turn it on.

tips.title: Emoji & Symbols
tips.tip: Find any emoji or symbol by name
tips.body: Type what you mean, like “party”, then Return to paste it.

tips.title: Scratch Notes
tips.tip: Jot something down without leaving
tips.body: The note floats over every app and keeps your place. Give it a hotkey to make it instant.

tips.title: Snippets
tips.tip: Type a keyword, get the whole text
tips.body: Try ;date or ;thx. Make your own with Create Snippet.

tips.title: Window Commands
tips.tip: Snap windows to halves and displays
tips.body: Type “left half” and press Return. Give your favorites a hotkey with ⌘K.

tips.title: Window Layouts
tips.tip: Put several apps where they go at once
tips.body: Make one with Create Window Layout, or save the one you have. Give each a hotkey.

tips.title: Search Screenshots
tips.tip: Find a screenshot by the text in it
tips.body: The text is read on your Mac. ↵ copies it, ⌘↵ pastes it where you were.

tips.title: Quick Look
tips.tip: Preview the selected file
tips.body: Select one in Search Screenshots and press Space. ↑ and ↓ move through them, Esc closes it.

tips.title: Several Screenshots at Once
tips.tip: Select several screenshots at once
tips.body: ⇧ and the arrows, ⌘-click or ⌘A. Then copy, paste or Quick Look them together.
